citations.case_name: Marlowe Freight, Inc. v. Castellan Mills, LLC
citations.quote: [The limitations clause] is enforceable against signatories and their successors.

citations.case_name: Marlowe Freight, Inc. v. Castellan Mills, LLC
citations.quote: A [trial] court must exclude expert testimony that rests on accepted methods if the expert has not applied those methods reliably to the facts of the case.

citations.case_name: Marlowe Freight, Inc. v. Castellan Mills, LLC
citations.quote: A district court must exclude [damages] expert testimony that rests on accepted methods if the expert has not applied those methods reliably to the facts of the case.

citations.case_name: Marlowe Freight, Inc. v. Castellan Mills, LLC
citations.quote: [A] district court must exclude expert testimony that rests on accepted methods if the expert has not applied those methods reliably to the facts of the case.

citations.case_name: Marlowe Freight, Inc. v. Castellan Mills, LLC
citations.quote: A district court [need not] exclude expert testimony that rests on accepted methods if the expert has not applied those methods reliably to the facts of the case.
